info.title: CallOps
info.description: Outbound AI voice-calling platform for a real-estate brokerage (PSI). Lead files are ingested into a durable dial list, dials are paced against the configured calling window and caps, project questions are answered from ingested project sheets under a cite-or-refuse discipline, each conversation is qualified into one of three outcomes, and a warm lead is handed to a human broker through a whispered summary and a conference bridge. Offline by contract in CI: no Store callbacks, no cloud LLM, and no outbound HTTP unless the operator opts a connector in. Optional CHADi pilot market egress (DXB Data MCP, dld-mcp data plane, Apify Bayut for-sale) is available under /v1/market/* when DXB_DATA_MCP_URL / DLD_QUERY_URL / APIFY_TOKEN are set; each answers not_configured otherwise and never fabricates numbers. Twilio remains stubbed until an account and caller number exist.

Ask this tenant's corpus, or describe the surface when no question is given.

A GET with no ``q`` states what this surface answers FROM -- the
precedence.v1 ladder, the layers this property's own corpus can supply,
and the label an answer with no higher source would carry -- so an
operator (or the console) can see which layer an answer comes from before
asking. That is the same label every answer below carries.
